textOffset.description: Sets an offset for the text's starting position.

blinkText.description: Blinks the text at the given interval (ms).

fadeText.description: Fades text on and off at the given interval (ms).

scrollSpeed.description: Percentage of the original scroll speed.

effect.description: Effect to display in the background.

effectSettings.description: Settings for color and speed of the effect.

icon.description: ID or filename of an icon to display.

bar.description: Draws a bargraph. Without icon maximum 16 values, with icon 11 values: [ 10, 20, 30, 40 ]

barBC.description: Color of the bar graph background.

line.description: Draws a linechart. Without icon maximum 16 values, with icon 11 values: [ 5, 15, 25, 35 ]

autoscale.description: Enables autoscaling for bar and line charts.

progressBC.description: Color of the progress bar background.

draw.description: Array of drawing instructions. Each object represents a drawing command. https://blueforcer.github.io/awtrix3/#/api?id=drawing-instructions

custom_app.description: Send a custom message to the Awtrix display.

device.description: The Awtrix device to delete the custom app.

app.description: The name of the custom app to delete.

delete_custom_app.description: Remove custom app from the Awtrix device.

device.description: The Awtrix device to put into deep sleep mode.

deep_sleep.description: Send the board in deep sleep mode (turns off the matrix as well), good for saving battery life.

device.description: The Awtrix device to switch apps on.

name.description: The name of the app to switch to. Built-in apps: Time, Date, Temperature, Humidity, Battery. For custom apps, use the name you set in the custom_app service.

switch_app.description: Directly switch to a specific app by name.

change_gui_config.description: Batch change configuration of all Powercalc config entries
